outcome.description: picked: task_id is the card the worker takes. blocked: nothing may be taken until a person acts, and blocked_reason says what. no_tasks: the board has nothing eligible left.

task_id.description: The card the worker is to take. Empty on anything but `picked`.

pr_number.description: Set only when the pick already has an open PR to continue -- a card that came back. The worker checks out that PR's branch instead of cutting a new one.

why.description: One sentence: why this card and not the one before it. It goes on the day's stream, so a wrong ordering rule is visible in the morning without opening a transcript.

skipped.description: Cards passed over and moved to `pending` because nobody could build them -- hardware, a real meeting. Not cards merely further down the board.

why.description: What is missing, in terms of what a person has to bring.

finished.description: Cards found in `in progress` whose work is already in `main` -- the session that built them landed the PR and died before moving the card. The orchestrator moves these to `in review`. Not cards you merely believe are done: each one names the commit that proves it.

why.description: Which PR merged and which commit in `main` carries it, so whoever reads the card can check rather than take it on trust.

blocked_reason.description: On `blocked`: which card stands in front of the pool, and what about it has to be settled before anything behind it is built. Empty otherwise.
